name: Extract Pressure & Scan Summary (R Script)
notes: Runs Extract_pressure_withOAZ1.R via Rscript.exe. Finds unprocessed .raw files under Y:/msdata/2026/yyyy_mm, converts them with msconvert.exe to extract pressure chromatograms, generates plots and appends to scansummary.csv. Requires R 4.2.0, ProteoWizard msconvert, and packages: tidyverse, ggplot2, cowplot, gridExtra. Script exits cleanly (status 0) when there is nothing to do. Update Rscript path if R version changes.
